findings.issue: Success check can false-positive. is_authenticated needs only 2 of 4 signals, and two of them are weak: left_login_page (any redirect off the login path, including to an error page) and browser_state_set (cookie NAMES diffed against a baseline taken BEFORE page.goto(login), so a csrf/consent/analytics cookie set by merely loading the login page counts). Reproduced with a fixture: login page sets a csrf cookie, bad credentials redirect to /fail -> ok=True with only left_login_page+browser_state_set. For an auth-test tool a false 'login passed' is the worst failure. (Live wrong-password login correctly returned False, so the live run is fine; this is a robustness gap.)
findings.fix_hint: Take the cookie baseline AFTER loading the login page (just before submit). Require at least one STRONG signal (logout_control or me_user, i.e. server-confirmed identity) plus one other; treat left_login_page and cookie-name-only as corroborating. Add a unit test for the csrf-cookie + error-redirect case. Optionally also check localStorage/sessionStorage token keys, since the criterion says 'cookie/token'.

findings.issue: Secret leak on the unhappy path. Playwright exception text for locator.fill() embeds the filled value (verified: a readonly password input with a 1s timeout yields an error containing the password). fill_login/login_once have no try/except, and __main__ --e2e only catches HostRefused, so any fill timeout, detached element or SPA re-render during login prints a raw traceback to stderr containing TEST_PASSWORD, bypassing safe_print/redact. FIELDS_JS filters disabled/invisible fields but not readonly or re-rendering fields. The 'no secrets in output' criterion only holds on the happy path.
findings.fix_hint: Wrap the e2e step bodies (and __main__ --e2e) in try/except Exception and report only type(e).__name__ plus sec.redact(str(e).splitlines()[0])[:120] as the step failure reason. Use a short per-fill timeout (e.g. 5s). The same exposure exists in fill_step for signup (DEV-003) and is reached by e2e, so fix at the e2e/__main__ boundary. Add a test that a failing fill does not surface the password.

findings.issue: CAPTCHA check is not run before each submit. run_signup checks once before the loop (line 258); the multi-step loop (while steps < max_steps) fills and clicks on every step with no re-check, and login_once checks only before fill and AFTER the click (the post-click check cannot prevent the submit). A CAPTCHA that loads late (async widget) or appears on step 2+ is never seen. FAIL-SAFE ANALYSIS: in committed code a detected CAPTCHA is never clicked, read or solved (detect runs first and returns; the widget is only touched by querySelector/className; the unit test proves an untouched widget and empty fields). A MISSED captcha leads to ordinary fill+submit, not a bypass attempt, and detect_captcha raising stops the run, so this is not a blocker. But the spec intent is detect -> STOP and a per-step check is one line. Detection is also DOM-only on class/id/iframe-src/body text: it misses <input name=captcha>, aria-label/alt/img[src*=captcha], Cloudflare 'Just a moment' interstitials, shadow DOM.
findings.fix_hint: Call detect_captcha at the top of every run_signup loop iteration (before fill_step) and immediately before the submit click in fill_login; return captcha_detected on hit. Extend selector with [name*=captcha i],[aria-label*=captcha i],img[src*=captcha i],.grecaptcha-badge, and add 'checking your browser|just a moment|unusual traffic' text variants. Add a test where the captcha appears on step 2.

findings.issue: logout() can pass vacuously. ok = not _me(page) and no logout control. If the site has no logout control and no /me-style endpoint (both guessed probes 404), or the guessed POST paths do nothing, logout reports ok=True although nothing was logged out; the later re-login then proves nothing about a fresh session. The probe loop also ignores that all POSTs failed. (Live run is fine: UI control exists, cookie list was empty after logout, and re-login produced a new sid value; I verified this.)
findings.fix_hint: Require positive evidence of session end: the auth cookie set at login is gone from ctx.cookies() (or its value changed), or a previously-passing me/logout-control signal now fails. If via=post and every probe is non-2xx, return ok=False reason=no_logout_path. For re-login freshness also compare cookie values (hash only, never print) against pre-logout values.

findings.issue: e2e always runs signup, so it is not re-runnable once .env.test exists: a second run fails at signup with 409 'Username already taken' (validation_failed) and never reaches login (reproduced). The dev-lead's project .env.test already exists, so a naive repeat of their e2e there will fail.
findings.fix_hint: If .env.test exists and has creds, skip signup (or try login first) and say so in the step output; or add a --fresh flag.

findings.issue: login_once navigates to login_url without its own check_url call; it relies on the caller having installed guard_context. e2e does (verified: context guarded, host checked at entry), but login_once/logout are public and the unit test calls them with an unguarded context.
findings.fix_hint: Call check_url(login_url) at the top of login_once (defence in depth).

findings.issue: Submit-button choice: LOGINBTN includes 'continue|submit' and 'sign in', so 'Sign in with Google' (OAuth) can win in document order, and the fallback is d['buttons'][0] (could be 'Forgot password'). Cross-origin is blocked by guard_context so it is contained, but login would fail confusingly. It also fills the first text field of the whole page extraction, not the form containing the password field.
findings.fix_hint: Prefer a button in the same form as the password input; exclude buttons matching google|github|facebook|apple|forgot; drop the buttons[0] fallback.

findings.issue: 'Evidence captured' is only stdout; nothing is persisted for the review trail.
findings.fix_hint: Write the redacted step list to runs/e2e-<host>.json (runs/ is gitignored) via redact().

findings.issue: NOT part of the DEV-004 commits, but observed in the concurrently-edited UNCOMMITTED working tree: fill_step now does loc.fill('test') for any required unmapped text field ('other'). In committed HEAD 'other' is skipped. Combined with DOM-only CAPTCHA detection (class/id only), a required <input name=captcha> with no captcha class/id would be filled with 'test', an interaction with a CAPTCHA field that the spec forbids. The working tree also showed 2 transient test failures mid-edit (65 pass on the final run), so someone is editing fill.py/test_fill.py during this review.
findings.fix_hint: Before that change lands, make detect_captcha also match input name/id/placeholder/aria-label containing captcha-like words, and have fill_step skip any field whose name/label/placeholder mentions captcha/robot/human.

After success, logs out then logs back in and re-confirms session (live: fresh context, cookies empty after logout, sid value changed on re-login)

End-to-end run against http://localhost:8889 passes the full chain (reproduced independently from a git-archive of HEAD: discovery, signup 201, login with 4 signals, logout via ui, re_login all PASS; no secrets in output)
CAPTCHA detected -> stop with failure reason, widget never touched, unit-tested on a fixture (signup and login); fail-safe holds, see major on coverage
criteria_missed: Success check via multiple signals: present but not robust (weak-signal false positive, no strong-signal requirement, token storage not checked) - see major #1
notes: Verdict revise: 0 blockers, 4 majors, 5 minors. TESTS: stage1 pass; committed HEAD (git archive) = 59 passed; working tree now 65 passed (uncommitted DEV-003 fill.py/test_fill.py edits by someone else are in flight; two transient failures seen mid-edit). LIVE: 8889 up; full e2e reproduced from the HEAD snapshot, all 5 steps PASS; wrong-password login correctly FAILS (no signals); a repeated e2e fails at signup (409). SAFETY CARRY-OVERS: all navigation/fetch goes through guard_context(check_url) in e2e (login probes /api/auth/me etc. are same-origin fetches inside the guarded context); creds only from .env.test (gitignored, 0600) via load_env_seed which registers values for redact; report goes through safe_print; step dicts hold booleans/paths/status codes only; no cookie values printed (my own checks printed only names/booleans/hash-equality). Probes: 404/SPA-HTML/non-JSON/{user:null} responses are all treated as no session (ME_JS returns null unless r.ok and JSON object with user/email/username), so a guessed 404 is never success. CAPTCHA fail-safe: never clicked/solved in any committed path; a missed detection only proceeds with ordinary fill/submit. DOUBT-DRIVEN: a nested fresh-context reviewer is not possible inside a subagent, so this was a degraded self-adversarial pass, but each doubt was settled with throwaway experiments (cookie-baseline false positive, password in Playwright error text, fresh-session value change, wrong-password, rerun) rather than argument; cross-model skipped (non-interactive). Security-and-hardening applied to: auth false-positive, secret exposure in logs, SSRF/allowlist boundary, session freshness, bot-detection. Known carry-overs not re-raised: WebSockets/service workers not covered by guard_context (debt.md). HIGH RISK: requires explicit user sign-off before DEV-004 is marked done even after fixes.
